verdict.rationale: Bento documents transactional email as its own message type, separate from broadcasts and sequences. It covers receipts, password resets and order confirmations, and the CLI can send transactional emails. That establishes a distinct transactional category. The evidence does not show the separation mechanics this story asks for: dedicated templates, suppression rules, or reputation isolation. Templates are described only as generic reusable assets for sequences and workflows. Missing for 10: evidence that transactional sends bypass marketing unsubscribes so receipts reach unsubscribed contacts, transactional-specific suppression rules, separate sending reputation or IP pools for transactional mail, transactional-specific templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
